title: hypocyrta fissa
intro: Hypocyrta fissa, commonly known as the Yellow Fungus or Lion's Mane Mushroom, is a species of fungus that belongs to the family of edible mushrooms. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Hypocyrta fissa include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties, which may help in the treatment of various diseases such as cancer, Alzheimer's, and Parkinson's. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polysaccharides, particularly beta-glucans, which have been shown to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antitumor activities.
